subject: Confidence Building
content: Setting small goals helps you build confidence. A goal is something you want to achieve. Small goals are easy to reach, like reading one book, learning five new words, or tying your shoes by yourself. When you reach a small goal, you feel proud and want to try bigger goals. Write down your goals or tell them to a parent. Celebrate when you finish a goal. Every time you reach a goal, your confidence grows. Start with easy goals first, then try harder ones as you get better.
summary: Small goals build confidence. Examples: read a book, learn five words, tie shoes. Reach goals, feel proud, then try bigger goals.
learning_objectives: Learn to set achievable small goals
nigerian_examples: Goal: Learn to spell your full name correctly
Goal: Finish homework before dinner for one week
Goal: Help with one chore at home every day

quiz_questions.question: What is a goal?
quiz_questions.explanation: A goal is something you work toward and want to accomplish.

quiz_questions.question: Why are small goals good for beginners?
options: They are easy to reach and build confidence
quiz_questions.correct_answer: They are easy to reach and build confidence
quiz_questions.explanation: Small goals are achievable, so you feel successful and want to try more.

quiz_questions.question: What should you do when you reach a goal?
quiz_questions.explanation: Celebrating your success makes you feel good and builds more confidence.

quiz_questions.question: Which is a good small goal for Grade 2?
quiz_questions.explanation: Reading one book is a small, achievable goal for a Grade 2 student.

quiz_questions.question: True or False: Only big goals matter. Small goals are not important.
quiz_questions.explanation: Small goals are very important because they build the confidence to tackle bigger goals.

subject: Confidence Building
content: Everyone feels afraid sometimes. Fear is normal. But you can learn to face your fears and become braver. First, name your fear. Say, 'I am afraid of speaking in class.' Next, take small steps. If you fear speaking, practice at home first. Then speak in front of one friend. Then try in class. Remember that mistakes are okay — everyone makes them. Breathe deeply when you feel scared. Tell yourself, 'I can do this.' Every time you face a fear, you get braver and more confident.
summary: Facing fears builds bravery. Name your fear, take small steps, practice. Breathe deeply, say 'I can do this.' Mistakes are okay.
nigerian_examples: Afraid of speaking in class? Practice answering at home first
Afraid of making friends? Smile and say hello to one person
Afraid of swimming? Start by putting your feet in the water

quiz_questions.question: Is it normal to feel afraid sometimes?
options: No, only weak people feel fear
quiz_questions.explanation: Fear is a normal emotion that everyone experiences.

quiz_questions.question: What should you do first when facing a fear?
quiz_questions.explanation: Naming your fear helps you understand what you are dealing with.

quiz_questions.question: What can you say to yourself when feeling scared?
quiz_questions.explanation: Positive self-talk like 'I can do this' helps build courage.

quiz_questions.question: What should you do if you make a mistake while trying something new?
options: Remember mistakes are okay and try again
quiz_questions.correct_answer: Remember mistakes are okay and try again
quiz_questions.explanation: Everyone makes mistakes. Learning from them helps you improve.

quiz_questions.question: True or False: Facing a fear makes you less brave.
quiz_questions.explanation: Facing fears actually makes you braver and more confident each time.

subject: Confidence Building
content: Self-talk is what you say to yourself in your head. Positive self-talk means saying kind, encouraging things to yourself. Instead of thinking 'I can't do this,' say 'I will try my best.' Instead of 'I'm not good at math,' say 'I am getting better at math every day.' Positive self-talk makes you feel strong and confident. Negative self-talk makes you feel sad and weak. Listen to the words in your head. If they are mean, change them to kind words. You are your own best cheerleader!
summary: Positive self-talk means saying kind words to yourself. Instead of 'I can't,' say 'I will try.' You are your own best cheerleader.
learning_objectives: Learn to replace negative thoughts with positive ones
nigerian_examples: Before a test, say 'I studied hard and I will do well'
Before a sports game, say 'I am strong and ready'
When something is hard, say 'I can learn this step by step'

quiz_questions.question: What is self-talk?
options: What you say to yourself in your head
quiz_questions.correct_answer: What you say to yourself in your head
quiz_questions.explanation: Self-talk is the inner voice that comments on everything you do.

quiz_questions.question: Which is an example of positive self-talk?
quiz_questions.explanation: Positive self-talk encourages you and focuses on effort.

quiz_questions.question: What should you do if you notice negative self-talk?
quiz_questions.explanation: Replace negative thoughts with positive, encouraging ones.

quiz_questions.question: Who is your own best cheerleader?
quiz_questions.explanation: You can encourage yourself through positive self-talk every day.

quiz_questions.question: True or False: Negative self-talk helps you do better.
quiz_questions.explanation: Negative self-talk makes you feel bad and less confident. Positive self-talk helps you succeed.

subject: Confidence Building
content: Asking for help is a sign of strength, not weakness. Everyone needs help sometimes — even teachers and parents! When you are stuck on a problem, don't know what to do, or feel confused, ask for help. You can ask a parent, teacher, older sibling, or friend. Say politely, 'Can you help me, please?' Tell them what you need help with. After they help, say 'Thank you.' Asking for help shows that you want to learn and get better. Confident people know when to ask for help.
summary: Asking for help is strength, not weakness. Ask parents, teachers, or friends politely. Say what you need. Say thank you. Confident people ask for help.
learning_objectives: Understand that asking for help is good
Learn how to ask for help politely
nigerian_examples: Asking a teacher to explain a math problem again
Asking a friend to help find a lost item
Asking a parent for help with homework

quiz_questions.question: Is asking for help a sign of weakness?
options: Yes, only weak people ask for help
No, it is a sign of strength
quiz_questions.correct_answer: No, it is a sign of strength
quiz_questions.explanation: Confident people know when they need help and are not afraid to ask.

quiz_questions.question: Who can you ask for help?
options: Parents, teachers, older siblings, and friends
quiz_questions.correct_answer: Parents, teachers, older siblings, and friends
quiz_questions.explanation: Many people in your life are ready to help you.

quiz_questions.question: What should you say when asking for help?
quiz_questions.explanation: Using polite words like 'please' shows respect.

quiz_questions.question: What should you say after someone helps you?
quiz_questions.explanation: Always thank people who take time to help you.

quiz_questions.question: True or False: You should never ask for help because you should know everything.
quiz_questions.explanation: No one knows everything. Asking for help is how we learn and grow.

subject: Confidence Building
content: Praising effort means celebrating how hard someone tried, not just the result. When you try your best, be proud of yourself even if you didn't win. Say to yourself, 'I worked really hard on this.' Praise your friends when they try hard, even if they make mistakes. Praising effort teaches that trying is what matters most. When you focus on effort, you are not afraid of making mistakes. You keep trying until you succeed. Every time you try hard, you are growing your brain and your confidence.
summary: Praise effort, not just results. Be proud when you try hard. Praise friends for trying. Effort helps you learn and grow. Trying matters most.
learning_objectives: Learn to praise yourself and others for trying
Build growth mindset through effort focus
nigerian_examples: Praising a friend who tried their best in a spelling bee, even if they didn't win
Being proud of yourself for studying hard, even with a fair grade
Encouraging a sibling who is learning a new skill

quiz_questions.question: What does praising effort mean?
quiz_questions.explanation: Effort praise focuses on trying hard, not just the final result.

quiz_questions.question: Should you praise yourself even if you didn't win?
options: Yes, if you tried your best
Only if others praise you first
quiz_questions.correct_answer: Yes, if you tried your best
quiz_questions.explanation: Being proud of your effort is important, win or lose.

quiz_questions.question: What happens when you focus on effort?
options: You keep trying and learn from mistakes
quiz_questions.correct_answer: You keep trying and learn from mistakes
quiz_questions.explanation: Effort focus helps you persist and grow, even when things are hard.

quiz_questions.question: How does praising effort help friends?
options: It encourages them to keep trying
It makes them want to quit
quiz_questions.correct_answer: It encourages them to keep trying
quiz_questions.explanation: When you praise a friend's effort, they feel supported and motivated.

quiz_questions.question: True or False: Only winning deserves praise.
quiz_questions.explanation: Winning is great, but trying hard and showing effort also deserve praise.
